events.description: MW: POOH 8 1/2" BHA with DP 5 1/2" + DP 5 7/8" from 3900 m to 2454 m wet, inside casing, at restricted speed of 2 min/stand. Obs.: - EDS#5 (CSR+LBSR / EHBS: LBSR). - Keeping SBP at 700 psi.
MW: Performing dynamic flow check with 400 gpm / 700 psi of SBP, Positive.

MW: POOH 8 1/2" BHA with DP 5 1/2" + DP 5 7/8" from 2454 m to 1884 m wet, inside casing and riser, with CMC open, at restricted speed of 2 min/stand. Obs.: - Selecting EDS#1 (NO SHEAR). - Keeping SBP at 620 psi.
MW: Lining up CU to choke line. Closing UBSR. Reducing SBP on MPD in steps of 50 psi until choke 100% open. Switching off booster pump. Obs.: -Selected EDS#3 (UBSR+LBSR / EHBS: LBSR).

MW: B/D and R/B 1x 5 7/8" DP stand. Connecting BART stand. Removing master bushing. Passing BART through RKB. Installing master bushing. RIH 1x 5 7/8" DP stand. Connecting TDS. Slacking off BART with 30 klbf and confirming latching with 20 klbf overpull. Slacking off 30 klbf and unlatching BA. B/D and R/B 1x 5 7/8" DP stand. Passing with BART + BA through the slip joint with CMC open. Removing master bushing and passing with BART + BA through the RKB. Installing master bushing. Inspecting and R/B BART + BA stand. Obs.: - Keeping SBP between 620 and 700 psi with CU
MW: POOH 8 1/2" BHA with DP 5 1/2" + DP 5 7/8" from 1884 m to 360 m wet, inside riser. Obs.: - Keeping SBP between 620 and 700 psi with CU.
MW: B/D and R/B 8 1/2" BHA from 360 m to surface. Obs.: - Keeping SBP between 620 and 700 psi with CU.
MW: Inspecting 8 1/2" bit and EZ Sleeve. In parallel, servicing TDS.
MW: Moving 8 1/2" BHA from aux to main and screwing in dog sub and bit.
MW: Perform TBT to make up BHA.
MW: Making up dog sub and bit. Making up BHA from surface to 45 m.
MW: Making up BHA from 45 to 119 m. - Replacing elevator inserts from 5 7/8" to 5 1/2"
AW: Holding pre job safety meeting.
